description: This file defines a custom React hook, 'useActiveSection', which tracks the currently active section in a webpage based on viewport intersection. It utilizes the IntersectionObserver API to monitor DOM elements by IDs and determines which section is most visible to update the active section state accordingly.

methods.name: useActiveSection(sectionIds)
methods.description: Custom React hook that observes a list of section IDs and returns the ID of the currently active section based on viewport intersection.
